# Return by 941

> iOS health tracking app that helps you maintain consistent wellness habits through beautiful daily metrics and insights.

For comprehensive information, see: [llms-full.txt](https://941return.com/llms-full.txt)

## About

Return is an iOS app designed to help you track daily health metrics and build lasting wellness habits. Track sleep, water intake, exercise, and more with a clean, intuitive interface.

## Key Features

- Daily health metric tracking
- Beautiful progress visualizations
- HealthKit integration for automatic data sync
- Customizable tracking categories
- Trend analysis and insights
- Widget support for quick logging
- Dark mode support

## App Details

- **Platform**: iOS / iPadOS
- **Developer**: 941 Apps, LLC
- **Website**: https://941return.com

## Privacy

Return prioritizes your privacy:
- Health data stored locally on device
- Optional HealthKit sync (your choice)
- No data sold to third parties
